Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js`: Returns `n` bounded to the range [min, max].
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js`: Formats byte counts using decimal units (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place.
- **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js`: Converts titles to URL-safe slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and removing non-alphanumeric characters.

All three are exported from their modules.
